reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and weekend shifting helpers, but repeats the daily skip policy instead of sharing the complete occurrence adjustment decision.

duplication.why: The skip-disabled, daily-skip, and otherwise-shift decision appears separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Handler registration and configuration types follow existing placement, but shared scheduling policy is also embedded in server handlers.

scope.why: All edits concern the requested scheduling rules, range handler, configuration field, or accompanying tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several policy implementations, while budget schedule enumeration still uses the lower-level shifting helper without the new configuration.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement policy alongside shared getNextDate, and repeat the new private isSkippedDay predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The nested ternary in getUpcomingDates and conditional returns in getDatesInRange reshape the same daily-versus-other adjustment decision implemented in getNextDate.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange separately implement the expanded policy.
